description: Search the npm / public packages catalog by free text — public npm packages — slid-phi, spl-pay-per-suite, shard-zip, shard-tsdb, and pulsar. Read-only; returns matching entries with name, price, notes, and links. Use to find an entry by keyword; use npm_get when you already know the entry id.

q.description: Free-text query matched against entry id, name, notes, price, and URL. Omit or send an empty string to list every entry in the catalog.

name: npm_search
